title: Just Some Clothes
description: This mod adds a bunch of clothing that can be combined. Helmets can be given covers, and jackets and body armor can be worn at the same time. There is also compatibility with certain mods.
body:
**JustSomeClothes — Style, Protection, Individuality**

Adds a huge variety of realistic clothing, military gear, helmets, and vests.

**Features:**
- _Civilian shirts, jackets, pants (many colors)_
- _Military camos: EMR, Multicam, Woodland, UHD, Camish, MOH, Leveortin, SXT_
- _Helmets: Altyn (with toggleable visor), 6B47, Fast Helmet, Pilot Helmet, Officer cap, Cap_
- _Vests with underlayer system – wear a shirt under your armor!_
- _Tactical boots_
- _Full Cold Sweat temperature integration_
- _Craftable camouflage patterns_

Customize your look – from office worker to special forces. JustSomeClothes – more than just armor.

![Features of this mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1aeacafc3ff1811cc1b2a4bb3bfaaef084ad8ba.png)
